{{Top|leg}}
'''Subspace tight-beam transmission cores''' were integral components of an [[espionage droid]]'s secondary programming. The core was used to relay information collected by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to its handler, using a relatively secure tight beam transmission that was normally undetectable unless caught by a [[Dedicated energy receptor/Legends|dedicated energy receptor]]. [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]] produced the [[45-T InfoCore]].
